summary: A card for a shoulder armour you cut out yourself: fourteen flat panels off one A2 sheet, locked with tabs, no glue.
license_note: The design and artwork are CC BY-NC 4.0: print it, cut it, remix it, teach with it — credit it and do not sell it. The full legal code is beside the package at examples/manis-card/LICENSE. The repository code around the card stays MIT. NOTICE at https://mrdirno.github.io/vibe-cards/NOTICE.txt names this card's artwork among the files withheld from that MIT grant; nothing here enlarges or narrows what NOTICE withholds.
origin: Not a fork and not a repository of its own. This is a page-project inside mrdirno/vibe-cards, published on that repo's Pages surface, and its host repo's MIT is inherited by the code around the card rather than chosen for the design. The package arrived finished from another system and was rebuilt here: the commit that brought it in (f646571) kept the assets and rebuilt the composition, because the arriving layout ran its kicker under the photo and printed the card's own build log on the back. The front figure is a synthetic render and depicts no real person. Who operated that generation run is not recorded anywhere in this repository, and this file does not know it. The consumed-capability list the package ships is an intent it recorded, not an inventory a reader can call: no tab-and-slot solver exists in this package.
_note: L0, not L1. L0's clauses hold: this manifest is served at the url the card's chip carries, the page it names carries an account-free wishing well, and the repository has a LICENSE with a real SPDX id. L1 is not claimed on either of its added clauses. docs/EVALS.md is Card Studio's eval record, not this card's, so shipped changes here do not carry an eval meeting section 2. And nobody has built this object, so every dimension on the card is drawing arithmetic rather than a fit someone has measured. Section 3 says L0 when in doubt. This card has no AUTHORSHIP.md. Three of its siblings ship one disclosing human intent, selections and AI portions; this one does not, so who made the artwork is unrecorded here. This file states stable facts about this card only. An earlier version embedded byte counts, grep tallies and claims about what other files currently say; every one of those was falsified by the same commit that published them, including one that had claimed this very url was unreachable — a claim that would have been served inside the successful response to fetching it. A manifest that measures its own repository is false on arrival, so this one states no measurement at all.
